title: fix(metadata-protocol): a package rollback carries every item a revert step refused, and answers success: false
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27868

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the answer's declared shape and its `success` contract do not change, and no skill or doc describes the rollback's `failed[]` population

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`rollbackToPackageCommit` 现在把每一步 `revertCommit` 返回的逐项拒绝（例如非规范存储类型的恢复被拒）写进回滚自己的 `failed[]`，有任何一项被拒就答 `success: false`。
- 为什么改：之前只有抛错才进 `failed[]`，逐项拒绝被丢弃，管理员回滚一个包时被告知成功，实际上有的条目原样未动，包处于半回滚状态且毫无提示。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `rollbackToPackageCommit` 一个方法内部，答复形状不变（仍是 `{ commitId, error }`）；回滚继续越过被拒条目的行为不变。出问题直接 revert 本 PR 即可。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（`rollbackToPackageCommit` 循环里新增的 `for (const item of step.failed)`），然后 `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.rollback-carries-item-failures.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.rollback-carries-item-failures.test.ts`，预期 3 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`rollbackToPackageCommit` (`POST /packages/:id/rollback`) runs `revertCommit` once per newer `apply` commit. `revertCommit` reports an item it refuses in its **returned** per-item `failed[]` and does not throw; the rollback read only thrown errors, so a package left half rolled back answered `success: true` with an empty `failed[]`.

Now each returned per-item failure becomes one entry in the rollback's own `failed[]`:

- `commitId`: the commit the item belongs to;
- `error`: `Item 'TYPE/NAME' was not reverted: ` followed by the step's own `failed[].error`, which is already client-facing (the P11 withhold in `revertCommit` has run on it).

`success` stays `failed.length === 0`, so any refused item makes it false.

**Shape.** The declared answer, `RollbackToPackageCommitResponseSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`), types each `failed[]` entry as `{ commitId, error }`, with no item fields. So the item is named inside `error`, and no spec edit is made. The step's per-item `code` (for example `STORED_TYPE_NOT_CANONICAL`) has no field in that shape and is not carried. See Acceptance notes.

**What stays the same.**

- A refused item stops neither its commit nor the rollback. The step still reverts the item's neighbours and records its revert commit, so that commit is also listed in `revertedCommits`. A partly reverted commit therefore appears in both lists.
- A step that throws still lands as one `{ commitId, error }` entry, and the rollback goes on to the next commit.
- The HTTP route is unchanged: it still answers 200 with the result as `data`.

**Clause-②: no, and why it is not a narrowing.** The answer's shape is unchanged. What changes is `success` becoming `false` for a request that used to read `true`. The published contract already says this is the right answer: `RollbackToPackageCommitResponseSchema.success` is described as "True exactly when nothing failed", and the sibling `RevertPackageCommitResponseSchema` already answers `success: false` for the same refused item. The change brings the implementation back to its declared contract. It does not narrow an accept set or a published shape: every request accepted before is still accepted and gets the same shape. Hence plain `no`, with no `(narrowing)` arm, no `!` and no BREAKING note.

## Tests

New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.rollback-carries-item-failures.test.ts`. It runs through the real protocol and the real `SysMetadataRepository`, with an engine double that also serves the commit ledger, so `listCommits` plans the rollback itself. It is the same harness shape as `protocol.revert-stored-type-canonical.test.ts`. The package history is: target `c0`; `c1` creates a view; `c2` edits `view/grid`, edits `fields/a.b` (stored under the non-canonical type, which `revertCommit` refuses with `STORED_TYPE_NOT_CANONICAL`) and creates a view.

1. **Refused item.** `success: false`. `failed` has exactly one entry with keys `commitId` and `error`: commit `c2`, an error that names `fields/a.b` and quotes the step's refusal text. `revertedCommits` is `c1` and `c2`. Both created views are removed, `view/grid` is back to V1, and `fields/a.b` stays at V2.
2. **Control, all clean.** `{ success: true, revertedCommits: [c1, c2], failed: [] }`.
3. **Control, thrown step.** `c2` is listed but cannot be read. The result is `failed: [{ commitId: 'c2', error: "No commit 'c2'." }]`, and `c1` is still reverted.

The test imports `./protocol.js` from `src`, not through a package `exports` path, so no `dist` rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.

**Ablation.** Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, the anchor `for (const item of step.failed) {` is replaced by `for (const item of [] as typeof step.failed) {`, which drops the carried failures and gives the pre-fix behaviour. The predicted result was case 1 red and both controls green. That is what happened.

## Acceptance notes

- **The declared item shape is coarser than the step's.** `RollbackToPackageCommitResponseSchema.failed[]` has no `type`, `name` or `code`, so a client reads the refused item from `error` text and loses the step's machine code. The schema's `failed` description, "Every commit the rollback could not revert.", now also covers a partly reverted commit's refused items. Giving the rollback entry structured `type` / `name` / `code` fields would be a `packages/spec` change (a widening, so `Clause-②: yes`) and is out of this card's surface. carrier: none.
- **`check:engine-double-contract` ledger.** `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains the new test's engine double, written by `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write` as the gate prescribes. The new double holds the caller's `limit` (`check:objectql-double-limit`) and refuses any combinator other than `$or` (`check:where-matcher`).
- **In-flight intersection.** No open PR touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`. All 27 open PRs were read, including all 721 files of the Version Packages PR. The one in-flight branch in the same package, `claude/issue-27829-searchfields-credential-refused` (no PR yet), does not touch `protocol.ts`. `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` against it exits 0.

## Verification

Head `233b1f0e`, merged with `origin/main` (`0a370917`).

The union was run after the final commit, at `233b1f0e`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 69 families. All 69 were run, each exit code captured before any pipe, and every one exited 0. Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates --ran` answers "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 69 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".

At `c47a8170` the first union had four reds: `check:engine-double-contract` (ledger not updated), `check:objectql-double-limit` (the double was limit-blind), `check:where-matcher` (the double had no combinator refusal), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` / `check:lean-entry-closure` (exit 3, prerequisite not met: `dist` was missing). The first three were fixed in `233b1f0e`. The last two were measured after the build and are green.

The CI families are cited from this PR's check-runs once they report.
